text: {"assertions":["On 2026-02-13, plan drift was investigated in the VPC module at infra/terraform/vpc.tf, building on context from earlier plan drift work in the same file.","The plan drift issue manifested only on the staging read replica as an unexpected resource diff despite no manual edits to the resource.","The root cause was identified as an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation in the code.","The fix involved prefetching the relation in a single query, implemented in PR #1016 on branch fix/plan-drift-1.","The plan drift could be reproduced by running the Terraform plan twice consecutively with no changes in between.","After implementing the fix, a related flaky test improved from 88 failures per hundred runs to zero failures."]}
